title: Maximum Exposure Probability Floors and Horvitz-Thompson Risk under Exact Weighted Budgets
banked_reason: Delivered tier subfield below novelty_target field; paper_score_ceiling 6.5 < 7.4; not salvageable within scope.
gap_reasons: paper_score_ceiling 6.5 < 7.4, so the graded tier 'field' is capped at 'subfield'.
The model’s equal-size disjoint blocks, specific weighted half-budget, bounded target outcomes, and fixed HT estimator limit how far the result travels.
The uniform-fiber consistency threshold concerns that particular design, not the optimal-design frontier.
proof_attempt_summary: Discovery proved the all-law positivity endpoint and support face, exact unrestricted endpoint risk when 6 divides m, the unrestricted leading frontier, a strict hub-count mixing witness, and the fixed-n/critical/Lambert-W/fixed-m uniform-fiber phase diagram. Math and decision panels passed, but the general referee capped the package at subfield because its hard-fiber, equal-block, fixed-budget, bounded-outcome, fixed-HT scope was too narrow for field impact. The exact finite interior frontier remains an open nonlinear mixture problem and would require new research.
tldr: Under one exact weighted budget, the maximum common exposure floor over all assignment laws is \(\lfloor2m/3\rfloor/(2m)\), and every attaining law lies on the maximizing exposure face. When \(6\mid m\), the unrestricted and exchangeable fixed-HT risks at floor \(1/3\) both equal \(9/[2(m-1)]\); only the exchangeable endpoint law is unique. Across feasible floors, both frontiers share the sharp leading constant \(F(\alpha)\), rising from \(4\) to \(9/2\). Uniform randomization over the full fiber has a separate fixed-\(n\), critical-window, Lambert-\(W\), and fixed-\(m\) phase diagram, with consistency exactly when \(n=o(m\log m)\).
gap: Exposure-HT theory expresses risk through marginal and joint exposure probabilities, fixed-exposure work establishes an admissibility consequence, and recent network minimax theory provides broad rate bounds. None of the inspected primary sources solves the fixed ordinary-HT design problem under this hard weighted fiber, quantifies the finite positivity frontier, or identifies the logarithmic failure boundary for the uniform law. The exact finite interior frontier and its layer mixing remain unresolved.
fill: Establish a finite integer subclass frontier, a strict hub-count-mixing obstruction, the general maximum marginal floor, sharp joint-order bounds for the full frontier, explicit near-optimal designs, and a quantified uniform-fiber count/risk phase diagram; use these results to reduce, solve, or sharply delimit the remaining finite all-design optimization.
